title: Plan row
brief: A pricing plan as a dark row: plan name with a Most popular badge, a seat note, the monthly price and a Choose button. The row lights its border on hover, the button shows a ring on focus.

inspiration.note: Took the dark surface with one warm accent and a compact plan summary; ours is a single horizontal row, not a column of tiers.
Took the small bold status badge idea for Most popular; yellow fill, row layout and hover border are ours.
